# `aitbc bond appeal`

Appeal a slashing decision for a bond with optional evidence.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc bond appeal [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--bond-id` | text | — | yes | Bond ID. |
| `--reason` | text | — | no | Reason for the appeal |
| `--evidence` | text | — | no | Evidence URL or CID |
| `--coordinator-url` | text | — | no | Coordinator URL |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc bond appeal --bond-id <bond_id>
```
